name: time_duration_demo.k
model:
class Meeting {
  startTime:Time
  endTime:Time
  minDuration:Duration

  req endTime > startTime
}

meeting1:Meeting

req meeting1.startTime = 2025-12-07T09:00:00

req meeting1.endTime = 2025-12-07T10:30:00

req meeting1.minDuration = PT1H

class Task {
  estimatedDuration:Duration
  actualDuration:Duration

  req estimatedDuration >= PT0S

  req actualDuration >= PT0S

  req actualDuration <= estimatedDuration + estimatedDuration
}

task1:Task

req task1.estimatedDuration = PT2H30M

class VideoClip {
  length:Duration

  req length >= PT0S

  req length <= PT10M
}

clip1:VideoClip
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (meeting1 Ref)(task1 Ref)(clip1 Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Meeting (mk-Meeting (startTime Int)(endTime Int)(minDuration Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Task (mk-Task (estimatedDuration Int)(actualDuration Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((VideoClip (mk-VideoClip (length Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Meeting (sel-Meeting Meeting))
  (lift-Task (sel-Task Task))
  (lift-VideoClip (sel-VideoClip VideoClip))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Meeting ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Meeting (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Meeting ((this Ref)) Meeting
  (sel-Meeting (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Task ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Task (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Task ((this Ref)) Task
  (sel-Task (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-VideoClip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-VideoClip (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-VideoClip ((this Ref)) VideoClip
  (sel-VideoClip (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Meeting ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Meeting this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Task ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Task this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-VideoClip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-VideoClip this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.meeting1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!meeting1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (meeting1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.task1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!task1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (task1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.clip1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!clip1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (clip1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class Meeting:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for Meeting.startTime: ---

(define-fun Meeting.startTime ((this Ref)) Int
  (startTime (deref-Meeting this))
)

(define-fun Meeting!startTime ((this Ref)) Int
  (startTime (deref-Meeting this))
)

; --- getters for Meeting.endTime: ---

(define-fun Meeting.endTime ((this Ref)) Int
  (endTime (deref-Meeting this))
)

(define-fun Meeting!endTime ((this Ref)) Int
  (endTime (deref-Meeting this))
)

; --- getters for Meeting.minDuration: ---

(define-fun Meeting.minDuration ((this Ref)) Int
  (minDuration (deref-Meeting this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class Task:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for Task.estimatedDuration: ---

(define-fun Task.estimatedDuration ((this Ref)) Int
  (estimatedDuration (deref-Task this))
)

(define-fun Task!estimatedDuration ((this Ref)) Int
  (estimatedDuration (deref-Task this))
)

; --- getters for Task.actualDuration: ---

(define-fun Task!actualDuration ((this Ref)) Int
  (actualDuration (deref-Task this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class VideoClip:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for VideoClip.length: ---

(define-fun VideoClip!length ((this Ref)) Int
  (length (deref-VideoClip this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Meeting (TopLevelDeclarations!meeting1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Task (TopLevelDeclarations!task1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-VideoClip (TopLevelDeclarations!clip1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Meeting.startTime (TopLevelDeclarations!meeting1 this)) 1765098000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Meeting.endTime (TopLevelDeclarations!meeting1 this)) 1765103400000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Meeting.minDuration (TopLevelDeclarations!meeting1 this)) 3600000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Task.estimatedDuration (TopLevelDeclarations!task1 this)) 9000000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 0) :named _xkassert6))



; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Meeting:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Meeting Meeting)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Meeting.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Meeting!endTime this) (Meeting!startTime this))
)

(assert (! (Meeting.inv1 1) :named _xkassert7))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Task:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Task Task)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Task.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Task!estimatedDuration this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Task.inv1 2) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Task.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Task!actualDuration this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Task.inv2 2) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Task.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (Task!actualDuration this) (+ (Task!estimatedDuration this) (Task!estimatedDuration this)))
)

(assert (! (Task.inv3 2) :named _xkassert10))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class VideoClip:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-VideoClip VideoClip)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun VideoClip.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (VideoClip!length this) 0)
)

(assert (! (VideoClip.inv1 3) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun VideoClip.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (VideoClip!length this) 600000000)
)

(assert (! (VideoClip.inv2 3) :named _xkassert12))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Meeting const-1-Meeting))
        2 (lift-Task const-2-Task))
        3 (lift-VideoClip const-3-VideoClip))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-Task () Task
  (mk-Task 9000000000 0))
(define-fun const-3-VideoClip () VideoClip
  (mk-VideoClip 11797))
(define-fun const-1-Meeting () Meeting
  (mk-Meeting 1765098000000 1765103400000 3600000000))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (task1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (estimatedDuration (sel-Task a!1)) 9000000000)))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (> (endTime (sel-Meeting (select heap 1)))
   (startTime (sel-Meeting (select heap 1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (clip1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-VideoClip a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (meeting1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (minDuration (sel-Meeting a!1)) 3600000000)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (>= (actualDuration (sel-Task (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (meeting1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Meeting a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (>= (estimatedDuration (sel-Task (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (estimatedDuration (sel-Task (select heap 2)))
              (estimatedDuration (sel-Task (select heap 2))))))
  (<= (actualDuration (sel-Task (select heap 2))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (meeting1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (startTime (sel-Meeting a!1)) 1765098000000)))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (<= (length (sel-VideoClip (select heap 3))) 600000000))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (>= (length (sel-VideoClip (select heap 3))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (task1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Task a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (meeting1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (endTime (sel-Meeting a!1)) 1765103400000)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2 3)))
                  1
                  (lift-Meeting (mk-Meeting 1765098000000
                                            1765103400000
                                            3600000000)))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-Task (mk-Task 9000000000 0)))
         3
         (lift-VideoClip (mk-VideoClip 11797)))))
